purpose: 4-digit HS import detail for bare-metal codes (gold, silver, PGM, copper complex, aluminium, Ni/Pb/Zn/Sn) that the 2-digit chapter dataset cannot separate — notably splitting bullion (7108/7106) out of chapter 71 and the copper value chain (2603/7402/7403/7404) out of chapters 26/74.
source: tradestat.commerce.gov.in/eidb (DGCI&S) -- Commodity-wise All Countries Import report
method: Same session-cookie + CSRF workaround as tradestat_hsn dataset: GET /eidb/commodity_wise_all_countries_import for _token, then POST Eidbhscode_cmaci=<hs4>/EidbYear_cmaci=2025/EidbReport_cmaci=2 (US$ Million). Each response carries the two most recent fiscal years.
